name: AlGhafa
description: AlGhafa is a multiple-choice evaluation benchmark designed for Arabic large language models, addressing the scarcity of evaluation resources in Arabic NLP. It includes a collection of publicly available datasets and a newly introduced HandMade dataset with 8 billion tokens, enabling comprehensive evaluation of Arabic LLMs.
reputation: A niche Arabic LLM benchmark from the Arabic NLP community, useful for coverage but not as widely used as major multilingual leaderboards.
notes: Focuses on Arabic language models and includes toxicity evaluation; uses multiple-choice format.
